Add iOS App Shortcut

One-tap access from your iPhone Home Screen

  1. 1 Open the MettleMap website in Safari on your iPhone.
  2. 2 Tap Safari’s Share button (the square with an upward arrow). It is usually in the bottom toolbar.
  3. 3 In the Share menu, choose “Add to Home Screen”, then tap Add. The shortcut will appear on your Home Screen.

Sharing with Friends & Family: Just share this link! Every new visitor gets their own welcome setup screen and private cloud profile automatically.

Add MettleMap to Android

Create a Home Screen shortcut

  1. 1 Open the MettleMap website in Google Chrome on your Android phone. The site must be hosted on a secure HTTPS link.
  2. 2 Tap Chrome's ⋮ menu in the top-right corner.
  3. 3 Choose “Add to Home screen” or “Install app” (the wording depends on Chrome and the website), then confirm.

If you only see “Add to Home screen”, this creates a browser shortcut. A full installable PWA requires a web app manifest and service worker on the hosted site.

YOUR FITNESS COMPANION

Welcome to MettleMap

Built with purpose. Driven by progress.

One place to plan your meals, log nutrition, train smarter and track your daily progress. MettleMap combines practical fitness tools with AI-assisted insights to help you build consistent habits.

Get started in 3 steps

Make MettleMap yours.

  1. Open Profile and select Edit Stats. Set your body metrics, activity level, fitness goal and weekly diet preferences.
  2. Open Plan to generate meals for the selected day, or Snap/Log to record what you actually eat.
  3. Check Tracker every day and record your training in Workout. Review your progress over time.

Explore your features

Tracker

Your daily progress dashboard.

  1. Choose a date using the arrows or calendar to see the corresponding logs.
  2. Review calories, protein, carbs and fats against your nutrition goals.
  3. Log glasses of water and mark your protein, workout and sleep habits.
  4. Review logged meals and activity totals throughout the day.

Snap/Log

AI-assisted food and nutrition logging.

  1. Choose a date and meal slot. Upload food photos or describe your meal with quantities, then tap Analyze.
  2. Review and correct the estimated calories and macros before saving. You can also enter nutrition manually.
  3. Use the label mode to look up packaged foods or scan a nutrition label. Adjust the serving multiplier.
  4. Reuse meal shortcuts, or use the meal history to edit or delete earlier entries.

Plan

Personalized Indian meal suggestions.

  1. Choose the relevant date in Tracker, then open Plan and tap Generate Today’s Meal Plan.
  2. Review the suggested meals, portions and calorie/protein estimates based on your profile and dietary schedule.
  3. Open a meal’s recipe for ingredients, preparation steps and a YouTube recipe search link.
  4. Your plan is saved on this device for the selected date. Regenerate only if you want a different plan.

Workout

Build strength and track consistency.

  1. Choose a date and select muscle groups or follow the suggested split.
  2. Use the preset exercises or add your own from the exercise library. Record weights, reps and sets; use Last Session to autofill previous weights.
  3. Use the rest timer between sets, add core/cardio notes and save your workout log.
  4. Review exercise progress, personal records, training volume and the consistency calendar. Generate an AI weekly fitness review when needed.

Activity & health

Bring your activity into the tracker.

  1. Open the activity sync option in Tracker or Profile.
  2. Upload a fitness-app screenshot for AI extraction, or manually enter steps, active calories and workout details.
  3. Check the values and save them. This is screenshot/manual import, not continuous wearable sync.

Profile & preferences

Personalize goals and app appearance.

  1. Edit your stats and weekly diet schedule to update calorie and protein targets.
  2. Log weight and optional waist measurements for the selected date and review your check-in history.
  3. Choose Light, Dark or Auto theme and Auto, Haptic, Sound or Off for button feedback. Vibration availability depends on your browser; silent mode cannot be detected.

Backup & sharing

Manage your app data.

  1. In Profile, use Google account sign-in and Sync Drive Now to back up supported logs and settings, where configured.
  2. Use Download JSON Backup to keep a separate copy of your data.
  3. Copy the shareable app link to introduce friends and family to MettleMap.

Add MettleMap to your home screen

Quick access without searching for the website.

Follow the built-in shortcut guide for your device.

A note on AI & fitness

AI nutrition estimates, recipes and fitness suggestions are guidance, not precise measurements or medical advice. Check ingredients, portions and exercise suitability yourself. AI features require a working internet connection and service availability.

MettleMap Engine

Cloud AI Connected

AI meal analysis, food-photo recognition, nutrition-label reading and fitness screenshot analysis run through the secure MettleMap server. Your Gemini API key is stored on Cloudflare and is not needed on this device.

If AI is temporarily busy, MettleMap will still offer its built-in estimate as a fallback.

Google Health & Activity Sync

Import steps & workout burn into today's tracker

1. Snap / Upload Google Health Screenshot

Upload a screenshot from Google Health, Google Fit, Samsung Health, or Apple Health—AI extracts your steps, active calories & workout automatically.

2. Today's Steps & Workout Summary
Why Screenshot + Quick Sync? Mobile browsers block websites from reading Android Health Connect / Google Health directly for privacy. Uploading a 1-tap screenshot or entering your daily totals keeps your active calorie burn synced across devices without needing a separate Play Store app.
